spans.s:
m. (-धः)
A warrior, a soldier, a combatant.
E.
युध to fight, aff. अच्.

m. (-ख्यः)
A leader, a chief warrior.
E.
योध, and मुख्य chief.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Fighting, warring.
E.
युध to fight, शतृ aff.

m. (-रः)
A hero, a warrior.
E.
योध, and वीर a hero.

m. (-वः)
Mutual defiance, challenging or braving each other.
E.
योध a warrior, संराव cry or shout.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Carrying soldiers fit for war, (horses.)
E.
योध, and हर what takes.

m. (-धी)
A warrior.
E.
युध to fight, घिनुण् aff.

m. (-यः)
A warrior.
E.
युद्घ war, and ढक् aff.
